mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sso_link_challenge (token_hash, user_id, provider, issuer, external_subject, org_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{challenge.tokenHash}, #{challenge.userId}, #{challenge.provider}, #{challenge.issuer}, #{challenge.externalSubject}, #{challenge.orgId}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{expiryMinutes} MINUTE))
mapper.select: SELECT id, token_hash, user_id, provider, issuer, external_subject, org_id, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM sso_link_challenge WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()

SELECT id, token_hash, user_id, provider, issuer, external_subject, org_id, expires_at, consumed_at, created_at FROM sso_link_challenge WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP() FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sso_link_challenge SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP()
UPDATE sso_link_challenge SET consumed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
